# Bianca Diamonds

> Ethically crafted lab-grown diamond fine jewellery — IGI-certified rings, earrings, necklaces, pendants, and bracelets in BIS-hallmarked gold. Custom design, transparent pricing, and delivery across India.

Bianca Diamonds is a women-led jewellery house specializing in lab-grown diamonds. Pieces are independently graded (IGI) and composed for everyday wear and occasion dressing. Clients may book private consultations or enquire about bespoke commissions.

- [Home](https://www.biancadiamonds.com/): The House — brand overview and featured collections

- [Necklaces](https://www.biancadiamonds.com/fine-jewellery/necklaces): Collars, rivières, and statement neck pieces
- [Pendants](https://www.biancadiamonds.com/fine-jewellery/pendants): Pendant and chain designs
- [Bracelets](https://www.biancadiamonds.com/fine-jewellery/bracelets): Bangles, cuffs, and tennis styles
- [For Him](https://www.biancadiamonds.com/fine-jewellery/for-him): Refined bands and signet-inspired pieces

- [Butterfly Collection](https://www.biancadiamonds.com/butterfly-collection): High jewellery suite inspired by the house emblem
- [Cannes Showcase 2026](https://www.biancadiamonds.com/fine-jewellery/cannes-2026): Exclusive jewellery from Cannes Film Festival 2026
